mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.2% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which triggers a shift in investor expectations toward future monetary policy accommodation, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative or flat 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.2% over 3 months, or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 3-year rolling Rank IC tests.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which increases the likelihood of a near-term monetary policy response, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a negative or insignificant coefficient in a multivariate regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 106.0 over two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases the probability of a policy response and triggers a flight to equities, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive in 70% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a concurrent rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a demand shock driven by labor market weakness, which increases expectations of fiscal or monetary stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.3% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, signals persistent inflationary pressures that trigger a hawkish monetary policy stance, reducing equity risk appetite and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term has a positive or insignificant coefficient in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k per month for three consecutive months signals strong labor market momentum, which increases inflation expectations and leads to tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative in more than 60% of instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past four quarters, combined with a concurrent drop in residential construction (HOUST), indicates a weakening economic expansion, which increases the likelihood of policy intervention and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1.0% in 4 quarters and HOUST < 1200k
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.
